page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sgn7i-vws-m2.xlarge is a virtual workstation instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8369B processor with 4 dedicated vCPUs, 4 physical cores, and a single thread per core configuration running at 2.9 GHz. The system is equipped with 16.0 GB of RAM, providing 3.88 GB of memory per core. For hardware acceleration, it includes a fractional NVIDIA A10 GPU representing approximately 0.0833 of a full GPU, which delivers 2 GB of dedicated VRAM. This instance does not include local storage and operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks show average CPU capabilities, with a stress-ng single-core score of 1904.08 and a multi-core score of 7176.28. Geekbench testing yields a single-core score of 1554.0 and a multi-core score of 5066.0. Memory bandwidth is measured at 420.9 GB/sec for cached small blocks, but drops to 48.98 GB/sec for large uncached blocks. The instance exhibits weak memory performance overall, with a Passmark memory score of 1651.18 and a database operations score of 2055.62, both falling into the bottom 25% tier. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression is also weak, scoring in the bottom 10% at 21.1 GB/sec. Conversely, Redis SET operations perform adequately at 8.23 million operations per second, and static web serving throughput reaches 9.28 GB/sec.

The fractional GPU allocation makes this instance a qualitatively cost-effective option for workloads that require GPU acceleration but do not justify the cost of a dedicated full GPU. It is well-suited for entry-level virtual workstations, basic image processing, and small-scale language model inference, achieving 111.74 tokens per second for text generation on a 135M parameter model. However, due to its weak memory and database benchmark results, it is not recommended for memory-intensive database hosting or heavy multi-threaded data decompression tasks.
